newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grants free market soft wheat, barley, oats.
newsitem.headline: EU grants free market soft wheat, barley, oats.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday granted licences to export 77,350 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a minimum tax of 0.02 Ecus per tonne through its main export programme, grain traders said.
The EU also granted licences to export 35,000 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a maximum refund of 5.40 Ecus per tonne to African, Caribbean and Pacific countries.

The EU's cereals management committee also agreed the export of 3,000 tonnes of free-market barley to non-EU countries at a maximum refund of 12.50 Ecus per tonne. It also awarded 21,000 tonnes of free-market oats with a maximum refund of 24.95 Ecus.
